notes:
## New features
- **Receptor levels on contour sheets:** a new Sheet switch puts each receptor's calculated level in a neat tag beside its marker (the highest floor of a stack, marked "max"). Only current results are shown, never an out-of-date number.
- **Copy Table pastes into Word as a real table**, with a caption (assessment, project, scenario, quantity, method), a header row and right-aligned levels. Spreadsheets still receive plain columns. The confirmation is now a quiet status message instead of a dialog.
- **Results at a glance:** the Results header summarises the answer for the view you are in. Levels gives the highest level and where; BS 4142 gives how many receptors are adverse or worse; Internal and Max levels give how many exceed the criterion.
- **Padel court maxima in one click:** when padel courts have no maximum sound power, Results › Max levels offers to apply the published ball-strike value (LWAFmax 100 dB, DataKustik 2025 / VDI 3770) to all of them. Undo reverts it.
- The **Report pack** includes the 3D view (as framed in the 3D tab), and has a shortcut: ⇧⌘E.
- **Help › Copy Diagnostics** copies version, system and project-size details for a support request. No project content is included.

## Changes
- **dB labels have a soft contrasting halo**, so they stay legible over dark and busy contour bands.
- **Selected sources and receptors are clearly highlighted** with a teal ring and white keyline. Before, the highlight was hidden underneath the symbol.
- Opening a project shows its saved receptor levels again in the Inspector and the Inputs table, for receptors still where they were calculated.
- Maps imported from a PDF are named after the PDF and page (for example "Site plan · page 1") instead of an internal code. Maps imported earlier show as "PDF map · page 1".
- The Slice and Scenario pickers fit their names ("Single Hour" was cut off).
- Long project names in Settings end with an ellipsis, with the full name on hover.
- **Smaller project files:** the organisation logo embedded in each project is stored at a print-ready size (at most 1,600 px), as JPEG for opaque artwork and PNG for transparent artwork. With a photographic banner logo, every project is about 1.6 MB lighter. Existing projects shrink the next time they are saved.

## Bug fixes
- BS 4142 and Internal (BS 8233) only treated a period as night when it was named exactly "Night". Periods such as "Night-time", or a night period of at least 4 hours starting between 22:00 and 01:00, used the day criteria (35 dB instead of 30 dB in bedrooms) and BS 4142's 1-hour instead of 15-minute reference. A short placeholder period, such as a single hour at 00:00, is still treated as day unless it is named night.
- Just opening the Contours tab marked the project as having unsaved changes (the sheet's camera and the one-time 0.19.0 style upgrade were counted as edits).
- In Select mode the pointer did not change to a hand over objects.
- Applying a saved appearance style preset in Settings failed (0.19.0).
